author: HotAndCrunch
body:
As you may know, I have left my team (SaberCross aka StormCloak) Because I was stressed and because everything was going downhill and I received a lot of insulting messages from previous members.


IGN: SparkzMC
KD: 1.41
Skype: patrick.willson01
Kills: 6361
Deaths: 4489
Position: Midfield or Offence or Rusher
Pros: I am very good at all ranges with a bow and decent with a sword, it takes a long time for me to get angry - I am mature, I do not let my head drop if we are losing by a huge amount in a scrim,GMT timezone, I do not get into any arguments, I can sort out most arguments and I am very modest.
Cons: I am clumsy and fall into the void easily and some people say I bow spam (I personally think it is a tactic). Also, my internet is very slow which leads to high ping (I got a grade D in an internet speed test). My internet might be upgraded soon meaning that I will be better at sword PVP
